The QB behavioral store computes pressure states from nflverse data, using a derived kernel that aligns with seasonal and positional frames. The scalarizer honesty gate ensures that only statistically robust models pass into production, enforcing a binary honesty condition via f1-score thresholds. These primitives form a closed-loop system where trust inference feeds into QB behavior modeling, which in turn validates model honesty. Failure modes include policy violations (AIRWAVE), data gaps (DATA_GAP), and breakdowns in temporal alignment or pressure computation. The system is designed to avoid false negatives through abstention rules and ensure calibrated outputs via the calibration store.
